title: Paloma and the Harvest
author: Casper Joubert
blurb: Silas Ashgrove, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
